hints.title: Median Minimizes Distance
hints.text: Sorting the house locations allows computing the optimal mailbox position for any contiguous segment at the median.

hints.title: Segment Precomputation
hints.text: Precalculate cost[i][j] as the minimal distance to cover houses from index i to j with a single mailbox placed at their median.

hints.title: Partition State
hints.text: Partition houses into k groups using a recurrence over (current house index, remaining mailboxes).

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Trying all mailbox placement coordinates on a continuous line is impossible without restricting to median intervals.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Precalculating O(N^2) interval median costs enables an efficient O(K * N^2) dynamic programming partition.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate realizes that for any subset of sorted houses served by one mailbox, placing it at the median minimizes L1 distance.
